مُشْتَبِكٌ : see شَابِكٌ, in two places. ―
-b2- رَحِمٌ مُشْتَبِكَةٌ (A'Obeyd, S, TA) means (tropical:) [Relationship by birth] closely, or intimately, connected. (A'Obeyd, TA.) And one says also, ↓ بَيْنَهُمَا أَرْحَامٌ مُتَشَابِكَةٌ (tropical:) [Between them two are relationships by birth closely, or intimately, connected]: and ↓ لُحْمَةٌ شَابِكَةٌ [which means the like]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
